title: Forty-eight years on a hairline.
excerpt: The station's licence renewal landed last week. A quiet milestone — and a reminder that everything WCDB sends out at 90.9 MHz still arrives via the same hair-thin signal it did in 1977.
body:
The station's licence renewal landed last week. A quiet milestone — and a reminder that everything WCDB sends out at 90.9 MHz still arrives via the same hair-thin signal it did in 1977.

We pulled the engineering logs going back to the original FCC filing. Forty-eight years of measurements, repairs, and midnight transmitter calls. Most of it still on paper.

title: The strange afterlife of the Ampex 354.
excerpt: Our oldest tape machine spent two decades in a closet before a returning alum coaxed it back to life. The capstan motor still hums like it did in 1986.

title: Why we still play vinyl in 2026.
excerpt: It's not nostalgia and it's not fidelity — it's the commitment. Cueing a 12-inch is a small public act of choosing this record over every other record.

title: What the spring pledge drive paid for.
